name: heavy-haul
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 文中以较大轴重和货运能力为特征的列车运营类型。

complete_examples.text: For the heavy-haul railway infrastructure, its supporting structure mainly includes the rail, sleeper, ballasted bed and bridge.
The heavy-haul train is modeled as a multi-rigid-body system, which includes a car body, four side frames, two bolsters and four wheelsets.
